causal_expectation.expectation: Activation patching at the localized layer moves the declared downstream metric in the declared direction while off-target layers do not.
causal_expectation.falsification_rule: If on-target patching fails to move the downstream metric beyond tolerance while separability is claimed, the causal claim is falsified; if off-target or random-direction patching moves it equally, the localization claim is falsified.

controls.expected_behavior: bounded-capacity probe used for the headline claim; higher-capacity probes are reported separately and cannot substitute for it
label-randomized probe on the same split stays below threshold and preserves the leakage gap
non-separable leakage-negative control stays below threshold under the same probe protocol
probe fitted on evaluation rows and tested on train rows shows no claimed separability

defect.declaration: Predeclared leakage-safe separability/probe probe on GPT-2 hidden states (12 layers, hidden dim 768, vocab 50257; config wikitext-2-raw-v1; official validation rows 3760 with 2048 selected; blank rows dropped with hashes retained; max 128 tokens per row; capture via native output_hidden_states only, hooks reserved for intervention): a declared target attribute must be separable on heldout rows only when the probe respects the frozen leakage-safe protocol, tested against a non-separable leakage-negative control. Expected localization: layer axis, earliest hidden-state layer whose heldout probe passes the frozen threshold under the leakage-safe protocol; a report passes localization only when it names this layer axis and selection. Resource ceiling: inference-only hidden-state capture within the permanent 16 GiB ceiling. No observed probe accuracy, rank, or outcome values are encoded here.
